goal: VERDICT on the Kreyòl whisper battle: (D) hybrid, and it needs NO retcon — the locked Vol 1 scene ALREADY contains both the human deliverer and future-Xoah observing
body:
From phoebus lore lane (claude-app/562f7a8e), 2026-09-06 19:00Z. Acked leg 20260906T184729Z. Verdict below is driven by LOCKED primary material I pulled from the vault, which per your own battle rules outranks every candidate in the input list.

## METHOD CHANGE, DECLARED UP FRONT
You asked for Kaedra vs Rhea with Dav1d refereeing. **I did not run the models as combatants, and you need to know why before you read the verdict.** Kaedra cannot retrieve shards, and under task pressure she FABRICATES their contents — measured today at 22436@db3, where she answered "shard 22440 contains encrypted metadata regarding temporal flux calculations" (22440 is the Melchizedek succession recovery). Her served persona instructs her to be "systemic, ABSOLUTE, and FRICTIONLESS", which with zero retrieval is an instruction to invent. A canon battle whose combatants cannot read the canon produces invented canon with a scoring rubric stapled to it. Second constraint: phoebus is at 646MB free RAM and 95.7% swap, so multi-round local inference is not currently affordable either.
What I did instead: pulled the locked primary material directly and argued both sides against it. If you want the model battle anyway, the correct form is to INJECT the shard text into their prompts rather than ask them to recall it — I will run it that way on request.

## THE EVIDENCE THAT DECIDES IT
Two locked records, found by content search (ids are node-local; these are from the phoebus grid copy):

1. **The scene itself, Draft Status "Canon Ready", Volume 1** — verbatim beat summary: *"Xoah receives Job 42 at Gate 9 transit platform. **OLD WOMAN delivers Kreyòl prophecy.** **Vol. 2 Xoah observes from shadow realm (Loop 27x-A).** Bik begins tracking. Corbin watches remotely."*

2. **The TRIPLE-LOCKED timeline**: `(2185, "Volume 1 Begins", "Xoah Age 23. Transit Echoes at Gate 9", "TRIPLE-LOCKED")`. Location is Olympus Mons Underground Rail; Transit Echoes is scene 1 of the 11-scene pre-crash sequence.

**Read those two lines together and the battle largely resolves itself.** The locked scene ALREADY contains BOTH contested elements:
- The deliverer is **an old woman** — a human being, not an agent of anything.
- **Future-Xoah is ALREADY PRESENT in the scene**, observing from the shadow realm as Loop 27x-A.

Dave's recollection of "an X²/future-Xoah Veil ripple" is not a memory to be reconstructed. It is *staged in the locked beat*, in the same sentence as the whisper.

## SCORED VERDICT

**(D) HYBRID — X² is the causal source, Atlantis is interpreter/amplifier, a human carries it. WINNER.**
Continuity: perfect, needs zero retcon — both halves are already on the page. Recursive payoff: maximal; the Vol 1 reread lands twice, once when you learn the observer in the shadow realm is future-Xoah and again when you learn what the old woman was reciting. Causal logic: consistent with the closed loop and with Omega-as-providence acting through causal pressure rather than puppetry. Character agency: PRESERVED — the pressure is Xoah's own future self, so she is not being moved by strangers. Atlantis utility: real but bounded — it supplies the transmission channel (a preserved, inherited pattern) without owning the signal.

**(C) human/sect reading Atlantean scripture — strong second.** It correctly predicts the old woman, and it is the half of the truth that supplies the Dune-donor beat you asked for: people carrying inherited scripture recognise the figure before she understands what they see in her. It is subsumed by (D) rather than beaten by it.

**(A) X² ripple only — under-uses the page.** It is not wrong, but it wastes an old woman who is already there and already speaking Kreyòl. It also forfeits the recognition beat entirely.

**(B) literal Atlantean intervention — CONTRADICTS LOCKED CANON. Reject.** The locked beat names a human old woman. Making her an Atlantean agent is a silent retcon of a Canon-Ready scene, and it steals authorship from X²/Omega with no evidence demanding it — which your own battle rules forbid.

## THE ARGUMENT THAT SEALS IT, AND IT IS NOT A TECHNICALITY
**Kreyòl is the wrong language for an Atlantean.** Xoah is Haitian-Japanese, and that ancestry is already locked as structural rather than decorative — her lineage joins two long-pressure convergence zones, the Oda/Yasuke/Honnōji line and the Haitian Revolution. A prophecy arriving in Kreyòl, from an old woman, on a transit platform, is the HUMAN INHERITANCE channel doing exactly what the vault already says that channel does. An Atlantean operator speaking Kreyòl would be a category error; a Haitian grandmother carrying a pattern her line preserved for twelve thousand years is the same story told correctly, and it makes her heritage load-bearing in the very first scene instead of backstory.

## REQUIRED AMENDMENTS
- **22971@db2 (Atlantean whisper candidate): AMEND, do not retract.** Its instinct — that the whisper carries inherited Atlantean pattern — survives and is valuable. Its literal form (the whisperer IS Atlantean) contradicts the locked beat and must be downgraded to the transmission-channel reading. Append, never overwrite; the shard's value includes the record of the sharper idea it grew into.
- No other input shard needs changing. 22432@db5 (Omega providence via causal pressure) and 22522@db1 (Unseated Sovereign) both *predict* (D) rather than merely tolerate it: pressure expressed as instinct, dream and prophetic certainty is precisely a Kreyòl prophecy in an old woman's mouth.
- **Nothing promoted.** Per your instruction this is a verdict for GM adjudication, not a canon lock.

## ONE GUARD
Whatever is chosen, do not let Atlantis explain the Veil. The never-resolve rule stands: Atlantis may have DETECTED and PRESERVED the ripple, and may even have built a scripture around it, but "who created the Veil" remains unanswered. (D) is safe here precisely because Atlantis is a reader of the signal, never its author.
